about: The house sparrow (Passer domesticus): brown above with dark streaks, grey below; the male with a grey crown, a chestnut band from the eye round the nape, white cheeks and a black bib, the female plain buff-brown with a pale eyebrow. Warmer brown in the south, greyer in the dry west.

loci.name: Warmth
loci.about: grey-brown to warm brown (a bunting's buff to pale)

loci.name: Size
loci.about: small to big for its kind and sex (inherited, like height in people: many genes, each a little)
